in_marathi.name: Agnisha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Fire
in_marathi.long_meaning: Agnisha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Agnisha is a Sanskrit name derived from the root 'agni' which means fire. In Hindu mythology, Agnisha is the goddess of fire, and she is also believed to be the consort of the god Agni. Agnisha is a symbol of purity, power, and transformation. She is often invoked during rituals and ceremonies to represent the transformative power of fire.
